scientific_integrity: Exact finite enumeration over 512 canonical inputs, justified for all lengths by a rank-three monochromatic truncation theorem and concatenation. Direct EF comparison tested on 14 boundary pairs. The 2009 Leeds thesis cited by the primary sources has not been inspected; independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only two-red finite linear orders at quantifier rank three; no claim about general two-colour orders or larger ranks. Rank-three finite lemma uses a complete executable certificate.
title: Exact three-round theories of finite two-marker coloured orders
